title: Buffer contents outside the written interval
statement: For any symbol alphabet $\Gamma$, word $w$, and integers $o,p$, the buffer-tape content at offset $p-o$ is unchanged by restricting it to the interval $[o,o+|w|)$: if $p$ is outside this interval, that content is blank.
